paite: Pathian inn a na hoh chiang in na khepek kem in; ngaikhe ding a pai, mihaite kithoihna piak sang in ahoihzaw ngal a; gilou ahih uh chih akithei kei uhi.
heading: Thuchiam Bawl Kin Lo Ke’n
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

paite: Kam lawp ke'nla, Pathian ma a thil himhim gen ding in na lungtang lawptawp kei hen; Pathian lah van ah a-om a, nang lah leitung ah na om ngal a; huaiziak in na thute tawmsak in.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

paite: Mang lah thu leh la tampi toh ahong om a; huan mihai aw thu tampi toh.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

paite: Pathian kiang a thuchiam na chiam chiang in, pe ding in hal ke'n; mihaite tung ah kipahna anei ngal kei a; na thuchiam pen pia in.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

paite: Na chiam a na piak louh sang in, na chiam louh ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

paite: Na kam in na sa thil ahihkhelhsak phal ke'n; angel ma ah leng, adik kei chi sam ke'n; bang ding in na aw ah Pathian in aheh in, na khut nasep ahihse dia?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

paite: Huchibang in mangte punna leh thute tamna ah bangmah loute a-om nak; himahleh nang zaw Pathian kihta in.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

paite: Gentheite hiamgamna in bial sung ah vaihawmna leh diktatna alamang chih na muhleh, huai thu lamdang sa ke'n; thuneitu sangte'n thuneihna neite a-enkai ua; huan amau tung ah asangzaw a-om hi.
heading: Hinna Phattuamna Bei Ahi
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

paite: Huai lou in lei a punna bang teng a ding ahi; kumpipa ngei leng louma in a-nna asepsak hi.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

paite: Kuapeuh dangka deihta dangka in alungkim kei ding; kuapeuh hauh-sakna punna deih taleng; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

paite: Van akibehlap chiang in, amau nete akhang uh; huan huai neimi a ding in bang phattuamna a-om a, amitte a huaite et chih ngal louh?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

paite: Ne tawm in ne tam taleh, semgimmi ihmut alim a; himahleh mihausa vahna in amah a-ihmusak kei hi.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

paite: Ni nuai a gilou hoih het lou ka muh a-om a, huai tuh, hauhsakna a neipa'n amah siatna ding a akep.
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

paite: Himahleh huai hauhsaknate thuakna gilou in amangthang hi; tapa asuanleh, akhut ah bangmah a-om kei.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

paite: Anu gil a kipan ahong paileh, vuaktang in apai nawn ding a hong pai bang in, asepgimna, akhut a apuakmang theih a ding in bangmah ala kei ding hi.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

paite: Huan hiai leng gilou hoih het lou ahi, ahong paidan tengteng in, hichibang in apai ding a; huih a ding a asepgimna ah bang punna anei a?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

paite: Adamsung teng in khomial ah an ane a, huan nakpitak a hihbuai in a-om a, chinatna leh thangpaihna anei hi.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

paite: Ngai in, hoih leh kilawm hi a ka muh mi'n Pathian in amah apiak adamsung teng a anek a, adawn a, ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a hoih asakpih a, huai ahi; hiai lah atantuan ahi ngal a.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

paite: Mi chiteng leng amah kiang a Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna apiak, huai a nektheihna apiak a, atantuan la ding leh asepgimna a kipak ding in; hiai Pathian thilpiak ahi.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

paite: Adam lai nite lah atheigige kei ding a; alungtang kipahna a Pathian in amah adawn ziak in.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.
